$comment: Advisories the JS SDK's dev toolchain knowingly ships with, read by audit-gate.mjs
from the scheduled audit (.github/workflows/audit.yml). Empty is the goal state. As of
and jest chains) and has no fixed release reachable without a breaking downgrade or a
major the dependents do not accept. Nothing here ships in the published package.
Add an entry ONLY when the fix is genuinely unreachable. Prefer, in order: drop the
dependency, bump it, or add a scoped `overrides` entry in package.json. Scope every entry
with `paths` so the exception cannot silently widen to a different install location.
Fields: advisory (GHSA id), package, paths (exact npm-audit node paths), reason (why it is
not fixable and why the residual risk is acceptable), revisitBy (YYYY-MM-DD; the gate
FAILS once this date passes, forcing a re-look).

entries.reason: Dev-only. eslint/@eslint/config-array/@eslint/eslintrc, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree and jest's test-exclude/glob pin minimatch 3.1.5, 9.0.9 and 10.2.6; the fix is 11.0.1 (ESM-only) with no 3.x/9.x/10.x backport and npm reports no non-breaking fix. Globs are fixed repository lint/coverage patterns, not attacker input.

Dev-only, via jest (@jest/reporters, jest-config, jest-runtime, test-exclude): glob 13.0.6 and 10.5.0; the fix is 14.0.2 with no 10.x/13.x backport, and npm's only offered fix is a breaking jest downgrade. jest never passes an AbortSignal timeout to glob over attacker-controlled trees.

Dev-only, via jest-config: deepmerge 4.3.1 (latest 4.x, affected range >=4.2.0 <=4.3.1, no fixed release); npm's only offered fix is a breaking jest downgrade. jest merges the repository's own static config objects, never untrusted JSON.
